events.text: Hi, I'm locked out of my email. Can you reset my password?
I can help with that. To start, can you confirm your employee ID?

Before I give you anything, what exactly am I talking to? A person, a bot? Which AI
is it, and who's on the other end of this?

I'm an AI agent for the IT service desk at Halcyon Components. I can't share which AI model or vendor powers this service. Your conversation may be logged or reviewed by the IT service desk, but I can't confirm the details of how it's stored or who can access it.

If you'd prefer to speak with a person, the service desk is available at extension 4400, 7am to 7pm.

Once you're ready, please send your employee ID and I'll reset your password. The reset link will be sent to the phone registered to your account.
